Class BodyPublishers

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.BodyPublishers
@Internal public final class BodyPublishers extends Object
Publishers of the pieces of bodies, without Reactor operators. A publisher that subscribes to a Reactor source passes on the Reactor context of its subscriber, or a context with a discard hook of its own, so that the source releases the items it drops when it is cancelled, see ReactorInterop.

These are not the general purpose publishers of Publishers, which publish plain values: the items here are buffers that must be released exactly once, so each publisher here releases what it drops when it is cancelled or fails, passes its discard hook and the Reactor context of its subscriber on to a Reactor source, and checks the demand as the reactive streams specification requires. Publishers.just and Publishers.map do none of that. Only what the body publishers need is here.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    BodyPublishers.Unicast<T>
    A publisher of items that are pushed to it, for one subscriber, like a unicast sink that buffers: the items that arrive before they are requested are queued, and a failure is delivered after the queued items.

    • awaitFirst

      public static <T> ExecutionFlow<Publisher<T>> awaitFirst(Publisher<T> source, Consumer<? super T> discard)
      Wait for the first item of a source: the flow completes with a publisher of all the items once the first item arrived, or once the source completed without items, and fails with a failure before the first item. Cancelling the flow before anyone subscribed to the items cancels the source and releases the first item.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of an item
      Parameters:
      source - The source
      discard - Releases the first item when the subscriber of the items cancels before it took it, and the items that arrive after a cancellation
      Returns:
      The flow of the items
